plugins.name: autofeature
plugins.description: Build an entire feature end-to-end from a single prompt. Pipeline: interrogate → scope → product-review → plan → branch → implement (parallel specialists) → test → review → ship → test-manifest. Includes /test (acceptance-test the live app — web/iOS/Android — building its own plan from what was built), /fullrun, /seo, /copy (de-AI copy audit + rewrite), /patterns (pattern census → per-repo coding canon → enforce + diff-check in every run), and the review lenses unified under /review [product|feature|market|scope] (also available standalone: /product-review, /feature-review, /market-review, /scope). Backend shape: /backend-api-skills audits, creates or refactors any backend API to route → controller → service → model — stack-adaptive (detects framework/ORM/validator/test runner instead of assuming Express+Mongoose), with a ranked violation catalogue and an identical-green gate on refactors; /api-standards is now a thin alias forwarding there. Ritchies platform: /ritchies (cross-repo API+web+iOS+Android feature builder, API-first + pick-clients), backed by a kotlin-compose-architect. Award interpretation: /award-map maps an Australian modern award into rosterio-compliance-service enumeration-first, so gap discovery terminates on a closure run instead of looping, and a merged PR isn't treated as live until promotion (Step 9.5) is gated behind a re-run against the one deployed database and explicit sign-off; /award-verify independently re-derives every rule row from its clause text to check it was read correctly, not just that it's reachable; /award-drift is the manual check for whether the award's own wording has moved since mapping, and re-authors with history preserved so historical pricing never silently breaks. Model-tiered for cost — the fan-out runs on Sonnet/Haiku, Opus only where it matters (orchestrator/model-tiers.md).
